console.help:
Console commands:
  help      Show this help
  status    Servers, players, Lavalink nodes and web panel
  servers   List the servers the bot is in
  sync      Register the slash commands on Discord
  reload    Reload the language files
  youtube   YouTube account: youtube [status | link | unlink | cancel | token <refresh token>]
  save      Save what is playing now (it comes back after a restart)
  stop      Shut the bot down gracefully
